33983f837730e433.desc: oskar med k’s infectious blend of chill house melodies and club-ready grooves proves that subtlety can hit just as hard as spectacle. The Oslo-based producer’s music thrives on emotional finesse that connects as deeply on the dance floor as it does through headphones. After breaking onto the scene in 2024 with his debut album, Keep Your Feet, he cultivated a growing fan base with a steady stream of hit singles. His 2025 release, “Make Me Feel,” propelled him to viral success. Its success opened the door to a major collaboration with Khalid, pairing his polished production style with one of pop and R&B’s most distinctive voices, further cementing his crossover appeal. His latest single, “i think i’m addicted,” a collaboration with Haley Joelle, explores a softer emotional register, balancing vocal intimacy with spacious, synth-led production. Alongside his growing body of work, oskar med k has established a remarkable live presence, selling out stages across Europe and North America. 339b42d2f87e9c6a.title: Brahms’ Second Piano Concerto
339b42d2f87e9c6a.desc: Leif Ove Andsnes calls Brahms’ Second Piano Concerto “glorious and happy music” that sets soloist and orchestra in a perfectly balanced dialogue. Despite its fiendish technical difficulty and symphony-like scale, Brahms’ Second doesn’t wear its heart on its sleeve but instead glows with carefully crafted elegance—especially in Andsnes’ capable hands that “[blend] intimacy and bravura” in the piece (Chicago Classical Review). The concert begins with the colorful, jazz-infused Latest by Paris-based composer Betsy Jolas, who turns 100 years old in 2026. Aptly titled, this percussive piece is one of Jolas’ more recent works, but certainly not her last. “Old age has fortunately not diminished my curiosity,” she says. “I’m still learning and I’m still trying things I’ve never done before.” Casual Friday concerts are shorter, no-intermission concerts followed by an onstage conversation with the artists and an after-party featuring LA Phil musicians, plus complimentary beer tastings.
